# AI build log

The company brief asks for maximum use of AI coders. This file records what was AI-generated, with which tool, and the key prompts.

**Tooling:** Claude Code (model: Claude Opus 5.5) in the terminal, acting as lead engineer. The human (Jay) supplied the brief, approved the plan, created the free Supabase project and Gemini key, and ran the interactive logins.

**Summary so far:** ~100% of code, SQL, config, seed data, scripts and docs were generated by Claude Code. Manual work was account creation and login only.

## Key prompts

1. **Master prompt** (the brief plus the zero-cost constraint, pasted verbatim): *"You are the lead engineer on a 2-day internship assignment. Build a Play-Store-ready Android MVP called 'BizSwap Gurgaon' … Seller flow — NO FORMS … Agents as Supabase Edge Functions … Zero-cost constraint: Gemini free tier, OpenStreetMap tiles, static gazetteer …"*
2. **Plan approval:** Claude proposed the folder structure, DB schema, agent contracts, screens and a Day 1/Day 2 milestone plan, and the human approved it.

| M0 Scaffold | `create-expo-app` run by the agent; all screens, theme, libs, `app.json`, `eas.json`, CLAUDE.md | none | The agent detected that Node 21 was too old for SDK 58 and installed Node 22 side by side. It read the MapLibre v11 type definitions instead of relying on memory, because the API changed in v11. |
| M1 Data lake | Full schema (18 tables), RLS policies, views, RPCs, gazetteer of 46 Gurgaon localities, 25 fictional listings and 10 buyer requirements via `scripts/gen-seed.mts` | `supabase login` | |
| M2 Agents | LLM adapter (Gemini Interactions API / Claude tool-use / Groq), zod-validated structured output with repair retry + provider fallback; intake, listing, valuation, matchmaker, watch agents; deterministic fallbacks; setup/deploy/smoke scripts | — | Agent probed the live Gemini API: `gemini-2.5-*` closed to new users, `gemini-3.8-flash` timed out on free tier → defaulted to `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` via the new Interactions API (~2 s/call). Smoke tests on the brief’s 3 sentences caught 3 bugs (specialty not extracted, "in Gurgaon" treated as an area, over-budget matches scoring 55%) — fixed with deterministic gap-fill + hard guards; all 19 checks pass. |

| M7 Release assets (part 1) | Store-asset generator (icon, adaptive icon, splash, favicon, 1024×500 feature graphic, 8 captioned 9:16 Play screenshots from the automated UI run), Play listing text + Data safety / content-rating answers, privacy policy HTML for GitHub Pages (same source as in-app screen), README with Mermaid architecture + seller sequence diagrams | — | All graphics rendered from code via headless Chrome; no design tools. Signed AAB/APK pending EAS login. |

## Runtime AI (inside the product)

The app's work is done by LLM agents at runtime: intake, listing, valuation, matchmaker and watch. Every call is logged to the `agent_runs` table with input, output, model and latency, so the company can audit exactly what the AI did.
